full_judgment: 1. Where a defendant against whom an exparte decree is passed applies under Order 9, rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure to set it aside and at the same time prefers an appeal from it, the Calcutta High Court has held that notwithstanding the pendency of appeal the original court may proceed with the application. Damodar vs Sarat Chandra, 13 CWN 846 and Kumud Nath vs Jathindra Nath, 38 Calcutta 394. The Allahabad High Court has also taken the same view. Mathura vs Ram Charan, 37 Allahabad 208; Gajaraj vs Swaminath, 39 Allahabad 13: Humani vs Azizuddin, 39 Allahabad 143. The extreme position taken by Madras High Court in Sankar vs Subdrajan, 30 Madras, 535 has not been followed by other High Courts.
